Name: Map Teleport - SVE Trailer Fix
Author: TNTpocket
Description:
About
This is an unofficial compatibility fix for [b]Map Teleport[/b].
[heading]Issue[/heading]
Clicking the [b]Trailer[/b] icon on the world map does nothing.
SMAPI reports:
[code][StardewValleyMapTeleport] No teleportation coordinate found.[/code][heading]Cause[/heading]
The SVE coordinate file uses:
[code]Town/PamHouse[/code]However, the current world map location ID is:
[code]Town/Trailer[/code][heading]Fix[/heading]
Changed:
[code]Town/PamHouse[/code]to:
[code]Town/Trailer[/code]The [b]Trailer[/b] teleport now works correctly.
[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Map Teleport[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley Expanded[/*]
[/list][heading]Installation[/heading]
Extract the files into:
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/code]When prompted, allow Windows to overwrite:
[code]MapTeleport/assets/sve_coordinates.json[/code]

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it contains files, but none of them are manifest.json.
